features: Direct Drive SSM for Quiet, Highly Precise Focus Lens Control
Five ED Glasses for Entire Zoom Range
Sony Nano AR Coating to Eliminate Flare and Ghosting
description: Boasting exceptional optics, a complete feature set, and outstanding speed in all aspects, the Sony Camera Lens FE 200–600 mm F5.6–6.3 G OSS easily takes its place as the telephoto zoom for professionals. Optimized for speed, this lens is equipped with a fast and constant aperture that will be an asset in creating images with shallow depth of field. Bokeh is made even better by the implementation of an eleven-blade aperture. ED glass elements that suppress chromatic aberration for maximum resolution and natural colour. The G lens has a lightweight design that helps in agile shooting and makes it easy to carry wherever you go to be an ideal photography partner for you. Explore the world with 200–600 mm zoom Perfect for wildlife and more, this 200–600mm super-telephoto zoom can reach as far as 840mm or 1200mm with 1.4x and 2.0x teleconverters, with full G lens quality and AF performance. Aspherical and ED glass elements achieve superb resolution throughout the zoom range, while Sony's Nano AR Coating cuts flare and ghosting. The bokeh is gorgeous, too.
